parsed.internal_thinking: 7 rolled, so I need to place the robber where it hurts the most. Claude is the main threat and has shown stone-control focus; he also bought a development card, so blocking his key growth is the priority. The best target is the stone-rich hex 5 (B6), because it feeds both Claude's nearby settlement at 25 and his stone expansion line, while also cutting into a strong production tile. It pressures the player who is most likely to leverage stone into tempo and keeps the table honest.
